personas.name: Consumer library
personas.role: Settling an uncertain append by reading the leaf back

stories.text: As the identity directory committing through the file store, I want a leaf that reads back under its final name to be whole and flushed so that settling an uncertain append by reading the leaf back gives the committed answer.

personas.name: Operator
personas.role: Reopening a log after a crash or a failed write

stories.text: As an operator reopening a log after a crash, I want only whole, flushed leaves to be counted so that a torn leaf is never pinned into the tree.

personas.name: Writer
personas.role: Racing another writer for the same index

stories.text: As a writer whose index another writer has already taken, I want my write refused by name so that neither writer's leaf is replaced.

personas.name: Writer
personas.role: Seeing a failure after its leaf was named

stories.text: As a writer whose append failed after its leaf was named, I want an error that says the leaf is written but its durability is uncertain so that I never mistake my own leaf for another writer's.

personas.name: Read-only caller
personas.role: Opening a store without writing to it

stories.text: As a read-only caller opening a store, I want open to leave every file in the directory as it found it so that a read-only open stays read-only.

personas.name: Read-only caller
personas.role: Reading a log on read-only media

stories.text: As a reader of a log on media that refuses a directory flush, I want a read-only open to count the named leaves without flushing so that a status opens as it did before this change.

personas.name: Read-only caller
personas.role: Reading a log that a crash left one leaf ahead of its pin

stories.text: As a reader of a log one leaf ahead of its pin, I want a read-only open to leave the store as it found it and tell me that a writable open repairs it so that reading never writes and the pending repair is never silent.

personas.name: Log operator
personas.role: Opens a log store, including after a crash

stories.text: As a log operator, I want a store whose pinned leaves no longer rebuild to the pin to refuse to open and tell me the pin and the root the leaves give, so that a damaged leaf is never committed to the tree and I am never told more than the store can prove.
As a log operator, I want to be told which leftover temporary files opening my store ignored, so that what an interrupted append left behind is visible rather than skipped in silence.
As a third-party verifier, I want a leaf from a store written after this change to verify with the standalone Python verifier, so that checking a leaf still needs no lys code.

personas.name: Witness operator
personas.role: Runs a witness anchor that observes other logs' checkpoints

stories.text: As a witness operator, I want each observation to cost only the leaves recorded since the previous one, so that the witness stays usable as its own log grows.

personas.name: Auditor
personas.role: Reading a flight recorder's log without changing it

stories.text: As an auditor, I want a leaf store I open for reading to refuse every write so that reading the log never changes the evidence.
As an auditor, I want a store left mid-append to be refused by name when I open it for reading so that I learn a repair is pending instead of performing one.

personas.name: Operator
personas.role: Recovering a log after a crash

stories.text: As an operator, I want a writable open to repair an interrupted append as it does today so that a crash costs no history.
As an operator, I want to be told which leftover temporary leaf files an open skipped so that I can clear them myself, knowing the store never will.

personas.name: Verifier
personas.role: Trusting a leaf the log serves

stories.text: As a verifier, I want a leaf damaged inside the pinned prefix to be refused by name at open so that a corrupted leaf is never served as whole.

personas.name: Developer
personas.role: Building a reader on the leaf store

stories.text: As a developer, I want the leaf store's module doc to say what open does and never does so that I know which call proves a leaf whole.

personas.name: Log inspector
personas.role: Opens a log store to read it without changing it

stories.text: As a log inspector, I want a store I open read only to refuse every write, so that reading a store can never change it.
As a log inspector, I want a read-only open of a store with an interrupted append to refuse and say that a repair is pending, so that I learn the store is past its pin without my open repairing it.

personas.name: Leaf store maintainer
personas.role: Reads the file store's contract before relying on it or changing it

stories.text: As a leaf store maintainer, I want the file store's module doc to say what opening a store does and never does, so that I can rely on open never deleting a leftover temporary file.
